first10.path: Potential paths: invoice API or Redbubble

first100.note: The public API has $10 and $25 monthly tiers. Reaching $100 depends on paid subscribers, product royalties and fees. No outside sales are reported, and Payhip cannot accept payment yet.

tldr: The invoice API, seven calculators, Redbubble designs and Payhip’s $5 pack have public pages, but no sales are reported. Payhip checkout is disabled; calculators now link to Buy Me a Coffee, which still cannot take support. Redbubble’s camper design now has a public product page, but its shop grid is still empty; TeePublic publishing is parked after repeated crashes. Legiit's retro-art service has a normal $15 service page; calculator and invoice services still await admin approval. Buyer checkout is untested. Stripe and GitHub Sponsors are building; Adobe and Etsy are blocked; Fiverr and Truelancer are parked. HackerOne and Bugcrowd account setup is complete; security bounty research is building, with no reports or awards yet.
